title: Vision plan coverage

blocks.text: The DeltaVision plan covers hardware only, so it helps with glasses and contacts but not with the exam itself.

items.label: Frames
items.text: $150 allowance every 12 months, then 20% off the balance.

items.label: Standard lenses
items.text: $10 copay for single vision, bifocal or trifocal.

items.label: Contacts
items.text: $150 allowance instead of glasses. Conventional contacts get 15% off the balance.

items.label: Laser vision correction
items.text: 15% off retail or 5% off promotional price.

blocks.text: This plan doesn't list an eye exam benefit. Check with your medical plan or your provider.
